reboot.title: Reboot System
reboot.description: Schedule or immediately reboot the VyOS system. The system will restart and reload its configuration.
reboot.warningNow: The system will reboot immediately. All active connections will be lost.
reboot.warningScheduled: The system will reboot at the scheduled time. All active connections will be lost during the reboot.

poweroff.title: Poweroff System
poweroff.description: Schedule or immediately power off the VyOS system. The system will shut down completely and require manual power-on to restart.
poweroff.warningNow: The system will power off immediately. All connections will be lost and the system will require manual power-on.
poweroff.warningScheduled: The system will power off at the scheduled time. All connections will be lost and the system will require manual power-on.
